name: Follow-up Email
description: Write a polite follow-up email after no response
promptTemplate:
Write a polite, concise follow-up email based on the following context. Reference the previous message briefly, restate the single ask, and keep it under 100 words:

"{{input}}"

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the email text, with a subject line on the first line. Do NOT include introductory notes or explanations.
